answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent must burn a copper deposit worth 30 days' earnings to claim one work slot, bound to a ferrous hardware key, so one machine yields one slot. Like cedar heartwood resisting rot for decades, the burn is sunk and cannot be recycled into a second identity. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 deposits, 3,000 days of earnings, while each slot's yield is capped at one share. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
